title: Bessent Says ‘I Am the House Now’ On the Yen: Is Bitcoin at Risk?
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Tuesday dared traders to bet against the Japanese yen, saying he now operates with inside knowledge of Japanese policy moves and challenging anyone to trade against him.
